offers_products.reason: Sells VIP cloud communications platform (UCaaS/CCaaS SaaS) and licenses its software platform to over 250 licensees.

offers_services.reason: Delivers hosted cloud telecom service (VoIP, UCaaS) with uptime guarantee and support; also telecom services to businesses.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are businesses, schools, nonprofits and partner licensees; no household-focused offering.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells cloud phone systems to businesses, school districts, nonprofits, and licensed telecom partners.

recurring_revenue.reason: Monthly subscription per-seat cloud phone service and platform licence fees recur on an ongoing basis.

cyclical_demand.reason: Business phone service is an essential operating utility; subscriptions are rarely cut, though seat counts may shrink.

big_ticket.reason: Small recurring monthly per-user subscriptions rather than large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for the cloud software platform and network, not mainly staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are small and mid-sized businesses, such as office-manager small business users, plus schools and licensees.

asset_heavy.reason: Software platform runs on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure rather than owned networks or plants; asset-light.

notes: Company has a cloud telecom service segment and a software segment; both are subscription-based, so answers are similar.
